title: Kaplansky decomposition into countably generated projectives
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $P$ be a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. There exist a set $I$, projective $R$-modules $P_i$ for $i\in I$, and an $R$-linear isomorphism $\bigoplus_{i\in I}P_i\cong P$, such that every $P_i$ is countably generated: it has an at most countable subset whose finite $R$-linear combinations exhaust $P_i$. Here $\bigoplus_{i\in I}P_i$ is the module of families $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ with $x_i\in P_i$ and only finitely many nonzero coordinates, with componentwise operations. No finite-generation hypothesis is imposed on $P$.

proof.text: By the canonical split-surjection form of [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], Mathlib Module.projective_def', choose a section a:P→(P→₀R) of Finsupp.linearCombination R id. The canonical free module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] P→₀R is linearly equivalent to the direct sum indexed by P of copies of R, by finsuppLEquivDirectSum. Each copy is generated by the countable singleton {1}, using r • 1 = r. This fixes the free-module index in the universe of P without restricting the universe of R.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-projective-kaplansky-direct-summand] to M=(P→₀R), J=P, N_j=R, the preceding direct-sum equivalence, and the section and canonical surjection. It gives I in the universe of P, modules Q_i in that same universe, countable generating subsets for all Q_i, and a linear equivalence e:(⊕_i Q_i)≃P.

Transport projectivity of P across e.symm using Mathlib Module.Projective.of_equiv', the isomorphism clause of [lem-weil-pbc-projective-direct-summand]. Mathlib Module.Projective.directSum_iff then supplies projectivity of each Q_i by its canonical inclusion and projection, whose composite is the identity. Combine this family of projectivity proofs with the countable generating sets and e from the preceding step.

lean.statement: theorem exists_directSum_countablyGenerated_projective (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (P : Type v) [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [Module.Projective R P] : ∃ (I : Type v) (Q : I → Type v) (_ : ∀ i, AddCommGroup (Q i)) (_ : ∀ i, Module R (Q i)), (∀ i, Module.Projective R (Q i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ s : Set (Q i), s.Countable ∧ Submodule.span R s = ⊤) ∧ Nonempty ((⨁ i : I, Q i) ≃ₗ[R] P)
